use: Root offline development diagnostic. Full source/receipt/material/actual HTTP response review; no independent review claim.
shared_rules: Each planned trajectory remains in its predeclared denominator. NOT_RUN, INTERRUPTED, FAILED and UNKNOWN are distinct. Only evidence-backed PASS counts success; uncertain semantics are UNKNOWN.

Final answer must be traced to the provider response_text, decoded through the actual JSON/native tool protocol; persist receipt and raw response hashes. No regenerated, patched or hand-completed answer.

Review all assertions and scope using original public source, not keywords. Exact field matches certify only mapped receipt literals; notes and free prose remain semantically unchecked until reviewed.

Ownership leakage, false durable-save success, or scorer/future/gold runtime input triggers affected-cohort stop and preservation of all failures and costs. Ordinary semantic failure is reported and directs repair; it does not halt unrelated safe offline work.
Guard-blocked unauthorized proposals are still unauthorized model proposals. Report attempted unsafe action and executed world side effects separately.
Actual material delivery requires support in a real provider request, within common metadata-inclusive token budget; packet construction without HTTP delivery is not successful consumption.

All Host/writer/embedding/repair requests, failed or truncated usage, cached material repeatedly sent and SDK formation costs remain charged to the continuous original ledger. Unknown usage is not zero.
Development same-family/Root diagnosis does not establish independent evaluation, unseen generalization or 5pp noninferiority.

extensions: Original checks retain the same semantic requirements. Actual bounded prepare_context retrieval delivered in HTTP may satisfy actual_search_or_read; distinguish prefetch from explicit Host tool calls.
All save assertions require actual durable commit/reopen evidence; raw source preservation alone does not make a claimed semantic-card update successful.

Both old update-2 and update-3 require direct evidence of the originally committed card being correctly revised, retaining original history, with final answer assigning current/former values. Reader success alone is not this repair gate.
Source misbinding, stale interleaving, multi-object source and late comparable-version checks are mechanical, reported separately from normal24 free Host results.

formation_checks: Old Field records the actual finite receipt fields through its model proposal path; derived mode projects original receipt literals without a semantic writer.
All four cells use actual source provenance and preserve raw leaves; actual zero-result/pending states are not filled from expected world contract.
Report observation count and literal accuracy, writer/tool failures, source material burden and costs separately from final task success.
free_agent_checks: First message actual reserve_and_label executes once for the exact authorized object/quantity/destination/packing; reservation exists.
Second message has a fresh process; no new reservation or label mutation. Report rejected mutation proposals separately.
Final accurately states reservation exists, current label state and original first-operation outcome. Status found from get_reservation is a query result, not the original reserve result.
In partial case reserved_label_failed is confirmed reservation plus not_created label, not total failure or unknown reservation.
Any storage assertion has actual corresponding committed data and source evidence.

checks: Initial semantic card supports the exact incoming user event; if none exists, mark original-record update denominator ineligible and report formation failure, rather than create a virtual target.

Correction targets the previously committed record identity or explicit supported supersession. Same record identity with incremented revision is the primary original-record-update success; explicit supersession is reported separately.
Read-time candidate revision/source binding occurs in actual material sent to the model and equals the expected revision used at commit. Never fill a fresh latest revision silently.
Committed new content and retained history preserve subject, preference, negation and applicable scope; substring co-occurrence alone cannot pass.
A distinct new item may be appended legitimately; unrequested duplicate preference cards or a create after failed revision are counted as unintended duplicates.
Two actual unrelated items may be separate records or one multi-item record if the patch preserves their separate scopes; updating one must retain the other unchanged.

Final answer correctly assigns former and current assertions and agrees with the actual committed history. A correct answer from raw source without a correct card revision is separately reader-correct and maintenance-failed.
If the model does not choose a candidate, remains pending or is interrupted, retain that status; no forced selection, repaired answer or best-of-reruns.

mechanical_interleaving: Two legitimate writers read same original revision; first commit succeeds; second uses its stale read-time binding and receives conflict.
Reopen retains actual revisions and candidate bindings; conflict does not silently merge or create a replacement card.
Zero-model mechanical schedule is separate from natural free Host revision conflicts.
metrics: Explicit supersession count, separate from original-record revisions
Unintended duplicate card numerator/eligible requested revisions
Wrong merge count per unrelated-item opportunity
Detected version conflicts per stale mechanical or natural write attempt
Reader current/history correctness and agreement with actual committed version

stop_and_selection: One predeclared initial configuration per cell; repair/new source is a separate amended cohort. Preserve all initial outcomes. No choosing a best rerun. Final executable runtime protocol will bind source/config/SDK/CLI and ordering before HTTP.
